text_block_list.text:
In her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Manhattan Cafe achieved tremendous success.

The forest of trophies looks like a skyline of skyscrapers.
And her streak of triumphs shows no signs of stopping—
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, hahahaha! Cafe,
even if you aren't out of breath, staying at that speed won't do!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san... I won't lose...
I'll surpass you... and reach my "friend."

Pushing each other to greater speeds,
they rewrote record after record. And then—

Before long... she came to be adored
by countless Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "A lot of customers... today as well... So... what is your consultation...?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, Cafe-san... About running on dirt,
I'm really not very good at it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Dirt... I see...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I think it's best... not to force your strength.
Just like swinging a pendulum... through the sand...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'm up next! I'm thinking of trying out the Front Runner style next time,
any tips?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Front-running... That's not my specialty, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"What's important is... awareness... Where you
place your heart's focus. How you run is merely an expression of that..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Could this be... even a small clue?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Would you like... some coffee before you go?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Trainer,
Cafe really is quite good at teaching, huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I seem to talk way too much.
And also, speed. Yes, speed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's the main focus of the research, after all. Dirt surfaces
or racing tactics—I know nothing about them, nor do I care.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Cafe gives spiritual advice
to all sorts of Umamusume
and steadily produces results.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to diversity, it seems they
have the upper hand."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe... Cafe-san,
your coffee is so delicious~

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Come now... don't rush to drink it down.
Fufu... fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And she looks like she's having fun, too.
It's practically a relaxation spot, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. The foundation itself is entirely different.
Come to think of it, that's where the difference lies.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Manhattan. A city lined with skyscrapers.
At a glance, it seems to strive for "height," but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"What we're truly aiming for
might just be 'prosperity.'"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Trainer...
Could we do one more lap, please?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd try out a new running style today...
If it helps someone... as a reference...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Lately, I've been thinking. Catching up
to the "friend" running ahead of me is important, too,
but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand... it's also important to support
the Umamusume who are chasing after you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm not as fast as my "friend"...
Even so, if I could quietly help from the shadows...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Opening my hands quietly... Someday, I will
support all the Umamusume. I'll become that kind of me...
(Screeech...!)

All of a sudden, Manhattan Cafe's figure
seemed to overlap with something...

The word "friend"... crosses my mind.
Though I've never seen their actual form...
choice_data_list: Hey, where is your "friend" right now?
Hey, where is your "friend" right now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Friend"...? Is that what you asked?
Of course they are here. Right by my side...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that's strange...
It was right there just a moment ago...
(Screeech...!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

I felt as if I heard... the voice of our “species.”
The continuously unbroken voice of the species known as Umamusume...

Yes, she is—
she truly is—
There is a fable about a certain Umamusume.

That Umamusume boasted near-ultimate speed,
and apparently looked quite similar to Manhattan Cafe.
Perhaps Manhattan Cafe had been dreaming this whole time...
"I had a dream... where that ultimate Umamusume appeared and wished, 'Become me, and surpass me.'"
